THE HOUSE METHOD

The model is the cargo.
We build the machine around it.

Any open model, today's or next year's, drops into a VF harness and inherits the whole system: orchestration, memory, evaluation, recovery, control surfaces. Swap the model, keep the machine. Every product below leaves the lab the same way: engine fitted, harness tuned, dashboard live, running on hardware the owner controls.

The slate is one discipline applied to many fields. VF Mail carries the first @vfempire.com inboxes on our own node. NAV·IT keeps every route inside VF infrastructure and ships inside FuelIT and MapIT. Guardian Shield supplies the vault primitive that seals VF Wallet, VF Legacy and VF Home. The products share code, signing keys and the same public proof.

Each product page follows one shape: why the system has to exist, who it serves, what it changes, the mechanics layer by layer, the build trajectory with release numbers, requirements and pricing where it is final. The security posture that backs every claim (two-of-two signing, reproducible builds, a transparency log, the Terms § 16 warranty) is documented once and applies to all of them. Firms that want the same discipline applied to their own product can commission it through the services desk.

Helmsman engineThe steering engine for frontier-class open models: installs, tunes and pilots large models on owned metal. The harnessProcess supervision, self-heal loops, project memory and evidence discipline: the frame that turns a raw model into a worker. Command dashboardsFleets, lanes, costs and outcomes on one pane of glass. If it runs, it is visible; if it drifts, it pages.

HOW THEY CONNECT

Shared parts,
shared proof.

The products are engineered as one family. Three connections matter most when you choose where to start.

One navigator, two products.

NAV·IT is the routing engine inside FuelIT and MapIT. VF never sells it as a standalone data business or SDK. Compare it with the mainstream option in NAV·IT vs Google Maps.

One vault, four products.

The Guardian Shield vault primitive seals VF Wallet, VF Legacy, VF Home and VF Mail. See how the vault compares with a standalone password manager in Guardian Shield vs Bitwarden.

One posture, every release.

Two-of-two threshold signing, reproducible builds, a public transparency log and the Permanence Guarantee apply to each product. The security page publishes the current audit; VF Mail vs Proton Mail shows the posture applied to email.

QUESTIONS

Asked.
Answered.

Which VF Empire products can I use today?

Two. SnapIT (P·20) is live at R·02a with one-off perpetual pricing from €59. VF Mail (P·16) is in Early Access: the first @vfempire.com inboxes run on our own node, the Windows and Linux builds are downloadable now, and the release stays free until the paid launch on November 1. Every other system carries an in-build or spec-complete chip on this page.

What does "spec complete" mean on a VF product tile?

The architecture, threat model, privacy model and build plan are written and published, and the runtime code is being implemented. Guardian Shield, FileIT, FuelIT, VF Wallet, VF Legacy and VF Home carry the chip. VF takes no subscription payment for a spec-complete product; Guardian Shield, for example, offers a founding-tier reserve with no card and no charge until R·01 ships.

Do VF systems need the cloud to run?

No. VF builds every system local-first: models, data and controls run on machines the owner holds. Where VF operates infrastructure itself, such as the VF Mail node or the NAV·IT origin server, it sits in EU jurisdiction on metal VF holds. Cloud capacity is an option when a client wants it and never the place your data has to live.

How is every VF product secured and verified?

Every product ships against one posture, published on the security page: two operators in separated EU jurisdictions sign each release, builds are reproducible from public source, releases enter a public transparency log, a bug bounty pays €500 to €25 000, and the Terms § 16 warranty refunds a material privacy breach with a public post-mortem within five business days, enforceable in Malta.

Can VF Empire build a system for my sector?

Yes. Every division on the slate started as one commissioned machine that had to exist. Write to info@vfempire.com with the problem; VF scopes the machine, builds it to tolerance and hands it over with dashboards, documentation and training. Firms that need CRA or GDPR documentation first can start with the fixed-fee engagements on the services page.

Where is VF Empire based and which markets does it serve?

VF Empire Corp Ltd is incorporated in Malta (C 94160), based in Għajnsielem, Gozo, and operating since 2019, with network companies in Germany and the United Kingdom. Products launch in Malta first; FuelIT covers nine EU countries and VF Wallet is planned with cross-border acceptance in DE, FR, IE and IT from day one. Every desk is listed on the contact page.
